LanguageData.GrechkaDestroy_OrderDesc: Order a pawn to disintegrate this entire item stack or corpse in 2 seconds. Nothing is recovered, including equipment on a corpse and the contents of packed items. The worker suffers −3 mood for 6 hours; repeating the task refreshes this penalty without stacking it.
LanguageData.GrechkaDestroy_CancelDesc: Cancel disintegration. The item remains intact until a pawn completes the task.
